summary: Full backend+frontend testing for NEXUSGAME iteration adding Midtrans (production) payments, testimonials, and admin panel. 13/13 pytest backend tests passed. Frontend flows verified: homepage testimonials section renders 4 seeded cards, nav-link-testimonials present, product modal shows Midtrans (default selected) + Stripe options, Buy button with Midtrans redirects to https://app.midtrans.com/snap/v4/redirection/... (real payment not completed). Admin login with 'Musangpandan' works; testimonials tab: table renders, add/save creates row, delete removes it. Products tab: add/save creates product and delete removes it (uses admin-row-{id} testid, NOT product-row-{id}). Orders tab (admin-tab-orders) shows METODE column with provider (stripe shown for existing orders). Backend webhook signature validation correct: 403 on invalid sig, 400 on mismatched gross_amount, 200 on valid signed settlement -> payment_status becomes 'paid'. gi-joki-abyss stock/sold restored to 99/567 after webhook test; pending test midtrans transactions cleaned from db.

issues: React console warning: <span> inside <option> causing HTML hydration error in AdminTestimonials.jsx rating <select> (line ~131). Likely dev-only instrumentation but flagged as production risk.
Empty string passed to attribute (warns about full page re-download). Product form image preview should render nothing (or null) instead of src=''.
Radix Dialog console warning: DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for screen-reader accessibility (add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py mark_paid decrements stock/sold via $inc {stock:-1, sold:1} for every paid webhook — safe due to payment_status guard, good.

midtrans_webhook validates gross_amount only against float equality; product price is int IDR so acceptable, but consider storing as int and comparing exact strings to avoid future float precision issues.
MIDTRANS_BASE resolves to app.midtrans.com (production) — confirmed. Do NOT complete real payments in preview env.
